class.name: HEGoStrataOutput
class.brief_description: Routes a cook's heightfields into the terrain layers an [HEGoStrataTargets] binds, and publishes them in one transaction. A volume names its target with the primitive attribute hegostrata_layer_path; the other attributes below describe its role.

method.name: to_houdini_attrs
method.description: Strata field metadata as Houdini primitive attributes. Other keys pass through as-is.

method.name: from_houdini_attrs
method.description: Fetched primitive attributes as Strata stores them, with the prefix removed.

method.name: prepare
method.description: Prebind every target to an instance and stable layer ID before asynchronous upload/cooking. Missing terrain input references fail a procedural cook.

method.name: handle
method.description: [param state] is what [method prepare] returned for this cook.

method.name: route_fields
method.description: This function also supports fixture/tests without starting a Houdini session.

constants.constant: Strata stores its field metadata under plain keys (role, channel, ...). In Houdini the same values are primitive attributes with this prefix, so they cannot collide with an HDA's own attributes.
